BillHeading.BriefDescription: Addressing noncollection of taxes by county treasurers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to noncollection of taxes by county treasurers; and amending RCW 84.56.250.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 84.56.250 and 2001 c 299 s 19 are each amended to read as follows:Penalty for willful noncollection or failure to file delinquent list.
BillSection.P: If any county treasurer willfully refuses or neglects to collect any taxes assessed upon personal property, where the same is collectible, or to file the delinquent list and affidavit, as herein provided in RCW 84.56.300, the treasurer shall be held, in his or her next settlement with the county legislative authority, liable for the whole amount of such taxes uncollected, and the same shall be deducted from his or her salary and applied to the several funds for which they were levied.
